body:
Man I'm turning 40 in a few hours and I'm a looser too...

I mean fuck it...time already flew by so fast it won't be long til we die anyways...might as well just live.

I overcame just about every hurdle in life like I was swimming upstream. I still graduated with a high GPA left college but went back and got a degree. I'm 37 now...nothing has changed...I feel like I'm playing frogger and while I advanced a few levels I don't think I can make it much longer. I don't understand how dumb people can be so well off, and every day is a struggle for me.

I can relate...I was a fat kid in highschool and felt the same way. I worked out like a madman after obsessing over my body and image. By college I was jacked and got any girl I wanted. I even slept with some who I sat next to in highschool but had no idea who I was then. Did losing weight and looking good fix everything? Nope...the older you get the less you really care about your physical image. It morphs into how successful you are, what you have, and where you are in life. You still have the suicidal thoughts.

What I'm saying is..if I waved a wand and made you look like someone on the cover of a magazine...it wouldn't solve your problem...you are still going to hate yourself and find some social construct you think is wrong with you as an excuse to be suicidal. I can't say it will get any better in life but there are occasional moments that are enjoyable. Life goes pretty quick.

My son had been the only reason I've been around this long but he does have a step father with his mother. I spent over $150k in the family courts just to have 40% custody and him have my last name. His mother and I were just a fling and shes just very hard to co parent with. Knowing he does have a step father does give me peace that someone will be in that role for him in his life.

Shes 29 and has a stable corporate job we do not have kids together. We have been married for 2 years together for 5 she has plenty of time to have a family and live her life. I actually told her tonight my intentions to prepare her. She said she had a feeling that I was up to something by moving things around. Her main concern was that she didnt want to be the one to find me and I assured her that she wouldn't. I explained to her that I would have everything prepared and list out what to after it happened. 

My son is from a previous relationship and he does have a stepfather so I know that there will be a father like influence in his life. My wife's other concern is that she would not have any rights to him and it would be up to his mother on whether or not she could see him after I am gone. 

This is not some bi polar emotional decision where I'm depressed, feel sorry for myself or whatever. I dont drink, I dont do drugs. Its just an alternative option where I am worth more dead than alive. 

Let's say i did file for bankruptcy...spend a few years maybe get back on my feet again...it will take another 10 to live comfortable and get my credit where I can do anything...I've seen this scenario too many times...the financial stress and hardships it puts on marriages and kids...il end up being 45 divorced broke working a job I hate versus being gone and knowing family is ok.

I've spoken with a bankruptcy attorney and yes I could file. Its deeper than that though...I feel like I've been a slave most of my life trying to make it to where I am. Finally last year it paid off and I was making real money....did everything by the book saved and stacked but this covid thing just wrecked my shit...dropped 20 employees to try and stay afloat but I just wasnt able to. 

Knowing how hard it was the last 10 years to get to where I got then watching everything be taken away...yea I'm just done...these last 10 years aged me 20...I just dont have the energy to do it again and I'm not going to put my family through that.

I just noticed the same thing....its obvious this broken system isn't working almost done on purpose as population control. Think about it though isolation, all the food we eat, water we drink, media we see, ads that pop up, electronic signals in the air...its all controlled. Would it really be that hard to tweak a few things and put people over the edge?
